title: Alicante Legacy Circular Network - Lines 14A, 14B and 39
notes: Circular-service discovery component for the map-defined Alicante urban legacy network.
14A and 14B are separate passenger-facing circular routes with independently ordered closesLoop=true patterns; neither is generated by reversing the other.
Line 39 retains independent open Ida and Vuelta patterns with closesLoop=false.
The later one-route Line 14 corridor is used only to reconcile legacy 14A/14B stop codes and geography; its Gran Vía Sur extension is not imported into the legacy loops.
Optional representation metadata. It is not authoritative simulation state.
